facts.business: Thomas Cook (India) Limited is India's leading integrated travel and travel-related financial services company, headquartered in Mumbai and backed by the Fairfax Group, operating across 28 countries and five continents through more than 800 customer touchpoints.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to transfer of control of promised services
Impairment risk of investments in subsidiaries
